motive.zhHans: 在 Otaro 车里发现的 Kyujiro 的头发，只是犯人为了嫁祸 Otaro 而设下的诡计，因为用敞篷车运送尸体是不可能的，而且我们也无法确定 Otaro 如果犯案会使用哪辆车。房间里发现开瓶器也是很正常的，因为有那么多啤酒。随后 Hiroko 指控 Masanari 杀害了 Otaro，因为他说自己当时在玩磁铁、喝啤酒。Kyujiro 知道他就是犯人，因为他在 Ohara 的房间里装了窃听器，知道这件事。他犯下的错误之一是带了开瓶器，因为 Otaro 描述的通往幸福的钥匙，其实就是他自己的特制开瓶器。房间被翻得乱七八糟，是因为 Ohara 需要取回牛磁铁，所以他在房间里制造混乱，以掩盖自己曾去寻找牛磁铁的事实。证据就是 Ohara 弄坏了自己的手表，这一点得到证实，因为他先前看的是墙上的挂钟而不是自己的手表。事实上，他是在掩饰自己杀害 Otaro 时受的伤，因为 Otaro 推了他，他撞到了一个瓶盖上。他随后声称自己杀害 Otaro 是因为 Otaro 想杀 Miona，但这只是他捏造的。
motive.en: The hair of Kyujiro found in Otaro's car was only a trick put by the culprit to frame Otaro since it wouldn't be possible to carry a body in a convertible and that we couldn't be sure which car Otaro would have used if he committed the crime. It would then be normal if a bottle opener was found in the room since there were so much beers. Hiroko then accused Masanari of having killed Otaro since he said he was playing with a magnet and drinking beer. Kyujiro knew he was the culprit since he planted bugs in Ohara's room and knew that. One of the mistakes he did was to bring a bottle opener since the key to happiness Otaro described was in fact his own personnalized beer opener. The room was ransacked since Ohara needed to retrieve the cow magnet so he put a mess in the room to hide the fact he went searching for the cow magnet. The proof is that Ohara broke his watch and it is proven since he looked at the clock wall earlier instead of looking his watch. In fact, he was trying to hide the fact he got an injury when he killed Otaro since Otaro pushed him and he bumped onto a bottle cap. He then said he killed Otaro since Otaro wanted to kill Miona but it was just made up by him.

resolution.zhHans: 所有客人都被叫到 Otaro 的房间里，小五郎事先已被躲在墙后的柯南弄晕。当他决定揭露案件真相时，所有人都激动起来。首先，Otaro 并没有杀害 Kyujiro。在 Otaro 车里发现的 Kyujiro 的头发，只是犯人为了嫁祸 Otaro 而设下的诡计，因为用敞篷车运送尸体是不可能的，而且我们也无法确定 Otaro 如果犯案会使用哪辆车。犯人还误算了一点：Otaro 会用自己的新车去杀人。接着，众人问他密室是怎么做的，小五郎让柯南做了演示。他先在门闩上放了一个开瓶器，然后在门的另一面固定了一个牛磁铁，用磁铁移动开瓶器，使门闩扣上，用两个门闩把房间锁住。然后他取下磁铁，摇晃门让开瓶器掉落。房间里发现开瓶器也是很正常的，因为有那么多啤酒。随后 Hiroko 指控 Masanari 杀害了 Otaro，因为他说自己当时在玩磁铁、喝啤酒。小五郎随后反驳，证明他说错了。他留下的死亡讯息并不是假面彗星 Byun 的标志，而实际上是反过来的。那个圆圈代表 O，那两条线代表片假名的 Ha，因此犯人就是 Shinsuke Ohara。他实际上就是七年前那起案件的另一名犯人。Kyujiro 知道他就是犯人，因为他在 Ohara 的房间里装了窃听器，知道这件事。他还带来了 Byun 的卡片来威胁他。他先在面包车里用自来水将 Kyujiro 溺死，然后把尸体弃在湖边。接着他杀害了 Otaro 来嫁祸他。他犯下的错误之一是带了开瓶器，因为 Otaro 描述的通往幸福的钥匙，其实就是他自己的特制开瓶器。Ohara 没有找到，便匆匆赶回厨房去拿。房间被翻得乱七八糟，是因为 Ohara 需要取回牛磁铁，所以他在房间里制造混乱，以掩盖自己曾去寻找牛磁铁的事实。证据就是 Ohara 弄坏了自己的手表，这一点得到证实，因为他先前看的是墙上的挂钟而不是自己的手表。原因在于，当他翻乱房间时，Fujiyoshi 发现了房间，他不得不从客房逃走并爬了三……。牛磁铁的磁力弄坏了手表。另一条线索是他平时把手表放在口袋里，但当时手表戴在手腕上。事实上，他是在掩饰自己杀害 Otaro 时受的伤，因为 Otaro 推了他，他撞到了一个瓶盖上。最终证据是那个瓶盖的形状与众不同，而与之对应的瓶盖会指认 Ohara 就是犯人。他随后声称自己杀害 Otaro 是因为 Otaro 想杀 Miona，但这只是他捏造的。Miona 随后回想起记忆，想起曾见过 Otaro 和 Ohara 的脸，并说出就是他。他随后被逮捕。
resolution.en: All the guests were called in Otaro's room where Kogoro had been knocked out beforehand by Conan who's hiding behind the wall. Everybody then got excited when he decided to reveal the truth of the case. First, Otaro didn't kill Kyujiro. The hair of Kyujiro found in Otaro's car was only a trick put by the culprit to frame Otaro since it wouldn't be possible to carry a body in a convertible and that we couldn't be sure which car Otaro would have used if he committed the crime. The culprit also miscalculated that Otaro would use his new car to kill someone. Then, people asked him how he did the locked room and Kogoro asked Conan to make a demonstration. He first put a bottle opener on the bolt and then fixed a cow magnet on the other side of the door and used the magnet to move the bottle opener which would close the bolt and lock the room with both bolts. He then removed the magnet and shook the door to make the opener fall. It would then be normal if a bottle opener was found in the room since there were so much beers. Hiroko then accused Masanari of having killed Otaro since he said he was playing with a magnet and drinking beer. Kogoro then replied by proving him wrong. The dying message he put wasn't the Masked Comet Byun's symbol but it was in fact backwards. The circle represented O and the two lines represented the katakana for Ha and so, the culprit was Shinsuke Ohara. He was in fact the other culprit in the seven years ago crime. Kyujiro knew he was the culprit since he planted bugs in Ohara's room and knew that. He also brought the Byun card to threathen him. He first drowned Kyujiro with tap water inside the van and dumped the body near the lake. He then killed Otaro to frame him. One of the mistakes he did was to bring a bottle opener since the key to happiness Otaro described was in fact his own personnalized beer opener. Ohara didn't find any so he hurried back to the kitchen to get one. The room was ransacked since Ohara needed to retrieve the cow magnet so he put a mess in the room to hide the fact he went searching for the cow magnet. The proof is that Ohara broke his watch and it is proven since he looked at the clock wall earlier instead of looking his watch. The reason why is that when he ransacked the room, Fujiyoshi discovered the room and he had to flee by the guest room and climbed the three. The cow magnet's magneticity broke the watch. Another clue is that he usually kept his watch in his pocket but it was on his wrist. In fact, he was trying to hide the fact he got an injury when he killed Otaro since Otaro pushed him and he bumped onto a bottle cap. The final proof is that the bottle cap's shape is different and that the corresponding one would point Ohara the culprit. He then said he killed Otaro since Otaro wanted to kill Miona but it was just made up by him. Miona then recalls back her memories and remembered seeing Otaro and Ohara's face and tells it was him. He is then arrested.
